**New Features / Improvements:**

* Added Windows executable icon to console and tray app.
* Added Monochrome macOS menu bar icon in tray app.
* Added start at system login option in tray app.
* Added automatic and manual update checking (both apps) with option for preview releases (tray app).
* Added about dialog in tray app and output in console app.
* Added donation options.
* Added log rotation logic in tray app that archives logs exceeding 10MB while only keeping last 3 archives.
* Added Codacy and SonarCloud integration with badges for README.
* Added ability to persist last proxy state when restarting tray app.
* Added timeout for incoming proxy headers.
* Added support for TCP half-close handling.
* Improved safety around preventing debugging symbols in release publish folder.
* Improved logging logic and content.
* Improved cognitive complexity in 3 more areas.
* Improved error handling of proxy startup failures.
* Improved tray proxy failure monitoring.
* Improved tray shutdown with failure handling.
* Updated release workflow to ensure debugging symbols are removed from release packages.
* Updated tray icon to simplify and occupy more space.
* Changed console timestamps to console logger for log reusability.

**Bug Fixes:**

* Fixed missing log entry for proxy state changes in tray app.
* Fixed console shutdown lifetime warnings.
* Fixed redundant console shutdown cancellation.
* Fixed various SonarCloud identified issues.
* Fixed CONNECT read-ahead handling.

**Known Issues / Limitations:**

* The Console app does not support saving proxy state across restarts, automatically starting at system login, logging to a file, nor checking for preview release updates. For these features, use the Tray app, which is better suited for these things.
